quotes.author: Vince Patton
quotes.text: What a treat! We loved our flight in "Pepita," one of three balloons they have. Floating in a balloon is the most peaceful way to see the surrounding landscape. John is an exceptionally experienced pilot and we felt exceptionally safe. I've flown in balloons twice before and it was nifty that this basket actually had a swing door; we did not have to climb in and out awkwardly. I'd forgotten how warm the flight would be given that we're standing right under a burner.

quotes.author: Laura Hansen
quotes.text: One of the coolest things to do, is to go up in a balloon with Okanagan Ballooning!!!They were very professional and easy going, I felt so relaxed!I was amazed how the family worked together! So in sync with each other!I felt so safe and could have flown all day!What an adventure! Thanks again for this most amazing experience!!

quotes.author: Manuela Cavalcanti
quotes.text: OMG what a glorious experience! Ballooning managed to be better than I could’ve imagined 🩵 the team at Okanagan ballooning was wonderful from beginning to the end. I felt safe and well cared for. 100/10 experience, I hope to repeat it many more times and bring some family members along next time! 😉

quotes.author: Cindy A
quotes.text: The team was professional, fun, entertaining, and very skilled at Piloting the Hot air balloon. This was an adventure and we would highly recommend it.

It was the best day of my life!! Id go up a again a million times !! It was so relaxing ; ) hours later and I cant stop smiling. I loved every second of it!! I wanna travel the world now and go up in hotair balloons every where that flys ;) !! It was better then I could have ever imagined!! ;) I hummed the song most of the flight....this is gonna be the best day of my life my life my lifffiieee!!
